_comment: Generated by api/tests/evidence_vectors_gen.py - do not hand-edit. Shared by the Python and browser evidence verifiers.

bundles.name: valid_full
bundles.description: Complete, anchored envelope bundle incl. tricky canonical-JSON payload.

bundles.name: valid_full_prod_test_ca
bundles.description: Fully verified under PRODUCTION rules: RFC 3161 token over this bundle's root, from a test TSA whose root is pinned for this vector.

bundles.name: prod_test_ca_tampered
bundles.description: The production-verified bundle with one event edited.

bundles.name: prod_test_ca_without_pin
bundles.description: The same production bundle under the REAL pin: the test TSA is not trusted.

bundles.name: valid_unanchored
bundles.description: Chain intact but not yet anchored: never fully verified.

bundles.name: empty_ledger_unanchored
bundles.description: No events: head is the zero hash.

bundles.name: uppercase_ledger_id
bundles.description: ledger_id is normalized like Python's str(UUID(...)).

bundles.name: revoked
bundles.description: A later envelope.revoked event: still a valid chain, displayed as revoked.

bundles.name: tampered_event_payload
bundles.description: An event's payload was edited after the fact.

bundles.name: tampered_event_actor
bundles.description: An event's actor was edited.

bundles.name: reordered_events
bundles.description: Two events swapped.

bundles.name: deleted_event
bundles.description: An event was removed from the middle of the chain.

bundles.name: tampered_head
bundles.description: Bundle head does not match the recomputed chain.

bundles.name: tampered_float
bundles.description: A float inside a nested payload changed.

bundles.name: broken_proof_hash
bundles.description: A Merkle proof sibling hash was altered.

bundles.name: broken_proof_side
bundles.description: A Merkle proof step's side was flipped.

bundles.name: leaf_not_head
bundles.description: Anchor leaf is not the bundle head.

bundles.name: bad_tsa_dev_wrong_imprint
bundles.description: Dev timestamp token over a different root.

bundles.name: bad_tsa_dev_token_in_prod
bundles.description: A dev-local token is not a trusted RFC 3161 timestamp.

bundles.name: bad_tsa_real_token_other_root
bundles.description: Genuine DigiCert token, but it timestamps a different root than the anchor's.

bundles.name: forged_root_with_real_token
bundles.description: Real token over a root the attacker chose; the leaf is not the chain head.

bundles.name: anchor_covers_earlier_event
bundles.description: Anchored when the ledger was 4 events long; 2 events were appended since. The completion is after the anchored part, so the proven status is unknown.

bundles.name: anchor_covers_earlier_event_prod_test_ca
bundles.description: The earlier-event anchor under PRODUCTION rules (test TSA pinned for this vector): proven up to the anchored event, not fully verified. Its envelope.completed is AFTER the anchored event, so it is unproven and never a PDF match.

bundles.name: anchor_covers_completion_then_webhook_prod_test_ca
bundles.description: Anchored at envelope.completed; a webhook outcome was appended after it (PRODUCTION rules, test TSA pinned).

bundles.name: forged_completion_after_anchor_prod_test_ca
bundles.description: A genuine anchored prefix + a forged, re-hashed envelope.completed after it (PRODUCTION rules, test TSA pinned): the forgery is unproven - no PDF match, no completed status.

bundles.name: anchor_covers_earlier_event_tampered_later
bundles.description: Same, with an event AFTER the anchored one edited: the chain still recomputes.

bundles.name: anchor_covers_earlier_event_tampered_covered
bundles.description: Same, with an event INSIDE the anchored part edited.

bundles.name: anchor_covers_earlier_event_broken_proof
bundles.description: Same, with the earlier event's Merkle proof altered.

bundles.name: two_signer_full
bundles.description: Full two-signer bundle.

bundles.name: redacted_valid
bundles.description: Recipient-scoped receipt (ADR-0020): co-recipient events redacted.

bundles.name: redacted_tampered_own_event
bundles.description: The signer's own event was edited in a receipt.

bundles.name: redacted_broken_link
bundles.description: A redacted event's prev_hash does not link.

bundles.name: redacted_swapped_hash
bundles.description: A redacted event's committed hash was replaced.

bundles.name: redacted_unanchored
bundles.description: Redacted receipt without an anchor cannot be trusted.

bundles.name: forged_record_redacted_stub_reroots
bundles.description: Forged events + a redacted stub carrying a genuine anchored leaf, under PRODUCTION rules (test TSA pinned): anchor checks pass, never fully verified.

bundles.name: forged_record_redacted_stub_reroots_dev
bundles.description: The same forgery with a dev-mode anchor.

bundles.name: malformed_missing_field
bundles.description: An event lacks this_hash.

bundles.name: malformed_not_object
bundles.description: Not an evidence bundle at all.
